subject: CloverBio — GPU onboarding roadmap & acceptance timeline
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Hugo Ramirez <hugo@cloverbio.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 02 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: CloverBio — GPU onboarding roadmap & acceptance timeline

Hugo — great meeting yesterday. Per our call, attaching the initial capacity matrix and a lightweight preflight checklist so we can converge on acceptance criteria before we lock the reserved pool. High-level proposal below.

Summary (proposal):
- Reserved capacity: 16 A100-equivalent GPUs initially (two-node availability zones), burst window to 24 for 72 hours on first swap.
- Traffic model: mirror 20% of production for 72 hours across canaries, then progressive ramp to 60% over 7 days.
- Acceptance gates: throughput (p95 token latency), functional parity on 100 canonical prompts, KV cache warmup within 30 minutes.
- Cutover windows: two candidate weekends (June 18–19 or July 2–3).

What I need from you:
1) Confirm target weekend preference (June or July).
2) Procurement readiness (PO or signed DocuSign) by May 20 to guarantee hardware slot.
3) Any additional compliance evidence needed for the staging cluster other than SOC 2 snapshot?

Attachments: capacity_matrix_v3.xlsx (workload curves + headroom), preflight_checklist.pdf

I'll loop Marissa and Karthik for the exact validation runbook; Ben will own the post-cutover cost tuning.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Principal Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Hugo Ramirez <hugo@cloverbio.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sally Chen <sally.chen@cloverbio.com>, procurement@cloverbio.com
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloverBio — GPU onboarding roadmap & acceptance timeline

Dylan — thanks, this looks clear. A few clarifications to help our SREs and procurement: 

- Weekend preference: June 18–19 is better for us (avoids a major release 6/30).
- Acceptance gates: can you expand on the "functional parity" tests? We run ~140 candidate prompts; will you run the set or do we push the canonical suite?
- Procurement: we can get a PO together by May 18 but will need the exact DocuSign link and final SOW to attach.
- Compliance: SOC 2 is sufficient for the staging cluster. We'll need an audit log export for the first 30 days post-cutover for our compliance team.

If you can provide a condensed validation runbook (checklist style) and the DocuSign URL, we'll accelerate internal sign-off.

Onward,
Hugo
Director of Platform Engineering
CloverBio

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 06 May 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Internal — CloverBio validation runbook draft and timeline

Team — drafting the compact runbook Dylan promised. Keeping it tight to limit customer friction but cover our SLA/cost checks. Draft plan below (we'll attach to DocuSign SOW as an exhibit).

Validation runbook (compact):
- Pre-swap (D-7): final capacity commit, baseline profiling (30min synthetic sweep), region provisioning verified. Owner: Karthik.
- Warm-up stage (D-1 to D+1): KV cache pre-warm using replay traffic; mirror 20% production to canaries. Owner: Dylan/Karthik.
- Canary day (D0): 20% mirrored traffic for 4h, run canonical 100-test suite every hour, monitor p95 token latency and tail retries. Failure thresholds -> automatic rollback. Owner: Ops on-call.
- Progressive ramp (D1–D7): 20% -> 60% -> 100% (read-only mirror to live writes until D+3). Daily sign-off from Clover SRE required at each ramp. Owner: Ben to coordinate cost adjustments.
- Post-cutover (D+7–D+30): 30-day audit log export, cost posture review, quantization/tuning pass.

Cutover timeline (per Hugo): target weekend June 18–19. Proposed milestone dates:
- May 18: signed DocuSign + PO (block hardware).
- May 20–30: capacity provisioning and staging cluster bake.
- June 8–12: preflight rehearsals (internal smoke + triple-canary).
- June 17: freeze for cutover (no infra changes).
- June 18–19: cutover window + canary monitoring.

Open questions for Dylan: does the customer require dedicated tenancy or VPC-private control plane for the staging? Also want to confirm the exact acceptance prompts set (Hugo mentioned 140). If they push 140 we'll run a sample 100 + high-risk subset.

I'll prepare the exhibit and push the DocuSign link to Hugo once we confirm the PO path.

- Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Hugo Ramirez <hugo@cloverbio.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, procurement@cloverbio.com
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloverBio — GPU onboarding roadmap & acceptance timeline

Hugo / team — thanks for the quick responses. We're aligned and I'm attaching the finalized runbook and the DocuSign envelope (docusign_cloverbio_v1.pdf) — DocuSign link below. Please review and sign by May 18 to keep the June 18–19 slot.

Final highlights and commitments:
- Capacity: locked to 16 A100-equivalents with 24-gpu burst on first 72-hour swap.
- Validation: Redwood will execute the canonical 100 prompt suite + your provided 40 high-risk prompts (total 140) during the canary window; results shared in shared Drive link.
- SLA targets during cutover: p95 token latency <= 380ms, error rate <0.3% across all endpoints. Automatic rollback on threshold breach.
- Audit logs: we will deliver a 30-day exported audit bundle in NDJSON format; SRE will get secure link by D+7.
- Cost ops: Ben will run a post-cutover tuning pass (quantization suggestions and batching profile) and propose expected cost delta by D+14.

Cutover checklist (short):
1) Signed DocuSign by May 18 (DocuSign: https://docusign.net/link/CloverBio-DBL-2027-091)
2) PO received by May 20
3) Staging cluster bake complete by June 12
4) Preflight rehearsal windows June 8–12
5) Freeze June 17; cutover June 18–19

Attachments: capacity_matrix_v3.xlsx, preflight_checklist.pdf, docusign_cloverbio_v1.pdf

On the tenancy question: we will provide a VPC-private control plane for staging (recommended) and the option to escalate to air-gapped on-prem package if procurement requires it. 

Next steps for Hugo: sign DocuSign, confirm PO flow (attached procurement contact), and provide the 40 high-risk prompt list by May 25.

Thanks — we look forward to a smooth cutover.

Best,
Dylan
Principal Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

--
Attachment stubs: capacity_matrix_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet, 120KB), preflight_checklist.pdf (document, 35KB), docusign_cloverbio_v1.pdf (envelope summary, 8KB)
